name: Cubic Normal Encoding
definition: Encodes a 3D normal vector into a 32-bit integer by projecting it onto the face of a cube with the largest absolute component, storing the sign of that component in the top bits, the face index in the next two bits, and the remaining two normalized coordinates in the lower 20 bits.
summary: Cubic Normal Encoding maps 3D normals to 32-bit integers via cubic projection, offering higher axis-aligned precision than octahedral encoding for sparse voxel octree storage.
